name: Vira Lata
description: Helena hides the fact that she is the daughter of a con man when she marries prosecutor Bráulio. While Stella searches for the children she abandoned, Lenin returns home and tries to rebuild his life.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Helena adopts a dog during lunch with Bráulio and is distraught upon hearing news about her husband. Lenin is arrested after a confrontation with criminals. Helena is distraught when she picks up her daughter from school.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Helena takes an unexpected step to try and find Giovanna's whereabouts. Lenin visits his father after a run-in with the police. Bráulio is suspicious of Helena's secrets.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Helena reveals her family's secret to Valquíria. Stela takes an unexpected action when she finds Ângelo with a lover. Lenin becomes worried about Lupércio's insanity.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Lenin escapes the police after a raid on Aurélio's hotel. Juliana discovers Giovanna's whereabouts. Bráulio makes a discovery about Helena's past. Lenin reunites with Fidel.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Cassandra tries to seduce Bráulio. Juliana finds Giovanna's whereabouts. Lenin is shaken after an unexpected encounter. Helena asks Moreira for help in finding Giovanna.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Helena and Bráulio find Giovanna's whereabouts. Lenin manages to extract a confession from Fred. Lenin advises Fidel to flee. Fidel despairs upon seeing Lenin being kidnapped.
